Makes another folder the current one, which is where relative paths start. Use [CurrentDir](CurrentDir) to see where you are.

```blitzbasic
;run
start$ = CurrentDir$()
CreateDir "files_change_example"
ChangeDir "files_change_example"
Print FileType(start$) <> 0
ChangeDir start$
DeleteDir "files_change_example"
```

```text
1
```
@param dir  The folder to go to.
